identity.lead: Experiments in keeping humans in control of AI-assisted work.

experiment.name: Capability Routing
experiment.context: A bounded workflow experiment: name the required specialist and the stopping condition before irreversible work.
experiment.question: How should an AI-assisted workflow know which specialist must act next—and when must it stop because the required capability is missing?
experiment.hypothesis: Before irreversible work, declare the required capability, applicable provider, authority inputs, expected outputs, deadline, and gate. If a required capability is unresolved, the workflow stops.

evidence.statement: A missing required visual provider blocks UI mutation instead of letting a generic fallback improvise the design.
An applicable brand or platform provider beats a generic provider, while a CloudAI-scoped provider is excluded from this GitHub Profile.
Route revisions and evaluation rounds stay append-only, so later decisions cannot silently rewrite earlier evidence.

experiment.next: Test the contract beyond this Profile and collect the smallest counterexamples where it routes the wrong specialist or closes the gate at the wrong time.

openLoop.continuity: Older repositories record a path from trial and error toward finishing and clarifying work.
openLoop.truth: writing-loop-harness worked locally and was useful, but it never became a clear, installable tool.
openLoop.closure: The loop closes when it becomes installable—not when it gets a more ambitious label.
